subject: Request: key passport, SRR and rotation playbook for SOC2 review

From: Alyssa Morgan <security@greenleaf.com>

Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: key passport, SRR and rotation playbook for SOC2 review

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — GreenLeaf's SOC2 lead asked us to collect a short set of artifacts focused on key management for our evidence package. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday if possible?

- A single-page "key passport" that explains KMS/HSM roles, KEK/DEK separation, and where keys live (Redwood hosted vs customer BYOK).
- The most recent Snapshot Reconciliation Report (SRR) or equivalent export showing key IDs and rotation timestamps for the last 90 days.
- Your KMS/HSM rotation playbook (high level): scheduled windows, blackout/maintenance handling, and emergency key eviction steps.
- Operator segmentation matrix that shows which RPs/operators have access to HSM admin functions (or attestations if you cannot share full matrix).

We will include the artifacts in our SOC2 workpapers and send back any follow-ups. If there are attachments you prefer to share via a secure link, that works too.

Thanks — specific contact for certs is Alyssa Morgan (security@greenleaf.com).

Regards,
Alyssa Morgan
Security Engineer
GreenLeaf Capital

----
Note: We may redact subject key IDs; the SRR can be CSV with hashed key identifiers.

Hi Alyssa — thanks, will do. Looping in Marissa (security & compliance ops) and Jonas (crypto ops) to pull the artifacts and confirm redaction guidance. Quick notes up front:

- We can produce a concise "key passport" PDF (single page) that explains KEK/DEK, where keys are generated, and the default retention windows.
- We will provide an SRR export (CSV) with hashed key identifiers and rotation timestamps for 120 days; let us know if you strictly need 90 days.
- Rotation playbook (PDF) and operator segmentation matrix (XLSX) can be attached.
- Emergency eviction steps include an auditable operator ceremony plus automated KV cache invalidation; we will include the test run log.

We should be able to send the package as attachments or a secure Drive folder by Friday EOD. Any specific classification/labeling your audit team requires for the SRR?

— Soojin

Forwarding artifacts — attaching the requested files and a short readme. See inline summary below.

Attachments (stubs):
- rotation-playbook-v3.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)
- srr-20260630.csv (CSV, hashed_key_id,last_rotation,previous_rotation,rotation_method)
- operator-segmentation-matrix.xlsx (XLSX, roles vs HSM privileges)
- kms-eviction-test-log.txt (TXT, runbook trace for emergency eviction test 2026-06-08)

Readme (excerpt):
- Key passport: page 1 of rotation-playbook-v3.pdf. Includes architecture diagram: customer BYOK (optional) vs Redwood managed KMS, HSM boundary, KEK wrapping flow, and default retention (rotation logs: 365 days; SRR snapshots: 180 days).
- SRR: we exported 120 days by default to be conservative; fields are hashed_key_id (SHA256 partial), last_rotation (ISO), rotation_type (scheduled|emergency|manual). We can trim to 90 days on request.
- Operator matrix: high-level mapping only — we redact personal identifiers but include role-to-privilege mapping.
- Eviction test: run completed in CI with two-operator separation and HSM vendor attestation; test log includes timestamps, operator IDs (redacted) and verification hashes.

Inline answer to Alyssa's question: you can include the SRR CSV in the SOC2 workpapers. If GreenLeaf prefers a secure link instead of attachments, state that and we will share a restricted Drive folder.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Hi Alyssa — one follow-up on retention and log granularity:

- Rotation logs: retained 365 days (full audit trail).
- SRR snapshots: we keep canned snapshots for 180 days; we provided a 120-day export to be safe. If you need the 90-day slice for your auditor we can trim.
- Ephemeral wrapping keys (used for short-lived tenant encryption): telemetry retained 90 days by default.
- Emergency eviction artifacts: we keep signed run records for 2 years; test logs included are timestamped and hashed for integrity.

Link to the procedural appendix and retention policy: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cKeyRetentionDocs-example

If GreenLeaf wants a redacted sample of raw HSM attestation (binary attestation summary), we can work with the HSM vendor to produce a short attestation PDF. Let us know how you want us to share these items (attachments vs secure link).

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Crypto Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
